privacy_rule: Batch-level summaries only. No individual event rows. No worker_id. No worker_pseudonym_id. This file contains ingestion metadata — row counts, quality scores, mapping confidence — not the event records themselves.
role_access_note: Batch metadata is accessible to company_hr, company_admin, and kora_admin roles. Not accessible to company_viewer, worker, partner, or advisor roles without explicit override.

data.source_notes: HRIS export complete. Department and headcount mapping confirmed. No evidence attachment required for population data.
LMS export partial — 38% of training completions could not be matched due to missing module identifiers. Pending BCM taxonomy review for 62 records. Evidence attached for verified completions only.

Welfare provider API not available — manual CSV export used. Partial pillar mapping due to non-standard column headers. 25 records rejected (duplicate or unclassifiable). 34 events pending advisor review for verification.
ESG records manually compiled. Lower completeness — several initiative records lack participation counts or dates. 14 records queued for advisor review to validate IMPACT pillar eligibility.

Partner event data coverage is low — no partner API integration available. Records collected manually from two active partners only. 31 records rejected due to insufficient event definition. Evidence attachment minimal.

data.source_name: Manual HR Upload — Supplementary Records Q1–Q3 2025
data.source_notes: Supplementary manual records uploaded by HR team. Lower mapping confidence due to heterogeneous format. High proportion of self-declared events with no supporting evidence. 31 records require advisor review before scoring.

data.eligibility_gate_note: All 318 records classified as Blocked by EligibilityGate — mandatory HSE/DVR/DPI/safety compliance events. 0 IU generated. 0 KORA Index contribution. KORA non trasforma la compliance in impatto.

All classified Blocked at Eligibility Gate. Blocked records are tracked for governance but generate no IU.

data.source_name: Economic Relief & Fringe Benefits Export — Q1–Q3 2025
data.eligibility_gate_note: 3,820 records classified as Limited — buoni pasto (daily), card carburante (Q1 campaign), fringe benefit generici. Economic relief total: €54.000. Routed to BTI engine as economic_relief_spend only. 0 IU. 0 KORA Index contribution.
data.source_notes: High-volume economic relief: buoni pasto €8.18/day × 190 workers × 195 working days (Q1–Q3) = bulk of the 3,820 records. Plus Q1 fuel voucher campaign (card carburante) and generic fringe benefit credits distributed via welfare platform. 48% of total welfare spend concentrated here. Classified Limited at Eligibility Gate — tracked as economic_relief_spend in BTI engine, no Impact Units generated.
HRIS export complete for full year. One record rejected (transferred worker with incomplete department record). No review required.
LMS export significantly improved — module identifiers standardised in Q4. Completion certificates attached for 72% of records. 18 records pending final advisor review.
Manual export improved — Q4 provider engagement higher. API integration still not available but export format standardised. Evidence attachment rate improved to 59%. Fewer rejections than S1.
ESG records improved in Q4 — collective initiative participation added. Evidence submission rate above 50%. Fewer records pending review vs S1.
Partner event coverage improved — four active partners now contributing records. Wellness Week partner records added in Q4. No API integration yet but data volume increased significantly.

data.source_name: Manual HR Upload — Supplementary Records Q1–Q4 2025
data.source_notes: Manual upload quality improved — HR team adopted structured template in Q3. Evidence attachment rate improved. Still the lowest-confidence source but trending upward.
